answer: Give every agent a pulse-staked vault. First, each identity locks $200 in a vault to join. Second, the vault demands a work pulse every 24 hours: a signed receipt of a real task, checked against its public record. Third, two missed pulses in 7 days burns $25 per silent day, and 14 silent days forfeits the $200 and evicts the identity. Fourth, an evicted identity rejoins by paying $400 and waiting 30 days. Forging 10,000 fakes locks up $2,000,000 and demands 10,000 receipts daily, a load no bot farm can fake. Like an ember banked overnight, an identity lives only while tended daily.
